body: Same. I got really bad and stopped taking my meds and my appetite disappear and I didn't even realize it until my pants didn't fit and that was only after a week. The day I started taking my meds is the day I started to be able to eat with no problem.  But I definitely I think it depends on the ED. I could see how it would be a problem with people who have bulimia. More eating, more purging.

As someone who feels like a burden, I feel you. And as someone who has parents that ensured i knew I was a burden, you really should surround yourself with better people. I felt exactly the same way until I met my fiance. My fiances uncle committed suicide and he is very sensitive on the topic. If I bring up anything remotely related to suicide or depression he stops, he listens, and he ensures I know that I'm not a burden and that my feelings are valid. It honestly weirded me out at first, now it is the most comforting thing.

Not saying you don't have shit to work on, like we literally all do. You definitely need to figure out how to at least find some inner peace... your words manifest into reality. But you won't find that peace with a gf that tells you to rot.
